Do not return hashes; the host binds immutable hashes.", "context": {"title": "David Copperfield", "unit": 5, "heading": "CHAPTER 3. I HAVE A CHANGE", "previous_rows": [{"source_id": "en85-u005-b0030", "target": "— Да как же, сэр, его отец и дал, — сказал мистер Пегготи.", "source_sha256": "e0f3dcee6be9b036c96d08929929e8f6b16991a72537dcb3f9a8490c4b5f971c", "target_id": "ru-en85-u005-b0030", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "bb2e4ec8d1a22bc57b60bcd6f28f36669d59b7f0a6f1da9e8c22d1b66590f00f"}, {"source_id": "en85-u005-b0031", "target": "— Я думал, вы его отец!", "source_sha256": "11ab3d0f1f10f4e9aaa256110167ca57311658bb95332481e494eded45aa7c20", "target_id": "ru-en85-u005-b0031", "tag": "p", "target_sha256": "cf34dddaa573a2718317e1817ed129bd98e9365e597228da4976314df5abec61"}], "source_language": "English", "part": null, "book": null, "chapter": 3, "role": "chapter"}, "source_rows": [{"id": "en85-u005-b0032", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘My brother Joe was his father,’ said Mr. Peggotty.", "sha256": "93325d71bb8d583a9e4c23f267471f523788be2630d2abafe2f88b5f36461f10", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[33]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0033", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Dead, Mr. Peggotty?’ I hinted, after a respectful pause.", "sha256": "236b9c165ae60b476ef012eb98d2db86a9248b9faab8940afa5297be7a5b965f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[34]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0034", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Drowndead,’ said Mr. Peggotty.", "sha256": "f24e67369395c6329838b96dd8e3134097373c23327a28713f01f7d39d46507c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[35]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0035", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I was very much surprised that Mr. Peggotty was not Ham’s father, and began to wonder whether I was mistaken about his relationship to anybody else there. I was so curious to know, that I made up my mind to have it out with Mr. Peggotty.", "sha256": "8719a10d3a8714cf1c3da064201c2847f27357b44246ced7f55c3607ae888d49", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[36]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0036", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Little Em’ly,’ I said, glancing at her. ‘She is your daughter, isn’t she, Mr. Peggotty?’", "sha256": "9b05e46548bd27c19ffab8278a7baaa045905e3f8066d53a0c5f258eb718e096", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[37]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0037", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, sir. My brother-in-law, Tom, was her father.’", "sha256": "12b206d0d71df5fb1c553769777b4d00a5ad07e2dedfe8a35a252a4326ee4e25", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[38]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0038", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I couldn’t help it. ‘—Dead, Mr. Peggotty?’ I hinted, after another respectful silence.", "sha256": "5542f8f9c9cf5c8d16750a72e06a99d93a2f701562fd787641e1215a84a39d5b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[39]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0039", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Drowndead,’ said Mr. Peggotty.", "sha256": "f24e67369395c6329838b96dd8e3134097373c23327a28713f01f7d39d46507c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[40]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0040", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I felt the difficulty of resuming the subject, but had not got to the bottom of it yet, and must get to the bottom somehow. So I said:", "sha256": "e7406ba04a5e656ea3a6a2390ad721f0a1e9a6825f3d1217f3c24264173ae7f3", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[41]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0041", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Haven’t you ANY children, Mr. Peggotty?’", "sha256": "7dced2874d1de266380125fe6f9282210c3dc13f968a8d84df93f6f8f543c266", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[42]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0042", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No, master,’ he answered with a short laugh. ‘I’m a bacheldore.’", "sha256": "67c4d04f875b3f4d5757f1dab23b5c63c18d697dc821c57f3435af4b020c1e24", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[43]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0043", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘A bachelor!’ I said, astonished. ‘Why, who’s that, Mr. Peggotty?’ pointing to the person in the apron who was knitting.", "sha256": "59320b73c8e948f731e3556896da65a227d9ea89c7c8fb508e304e9a359562db", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[44]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0044", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘That’s Missis Gummidge,’ said Mr. Peggotty.", "sha256": "dde678e756633496c51909d0c49c1eaa259e13cf6687b04fa7f2847515c8804e", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[45]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0045", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Gummidge, Mr. Peggotty?’", "sha256": "fe445ad12ef8fec290d41b25e70d78aa4386ed76d04757f1edb6b10573e55dc6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[46]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0046", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "But at this point Peggotty—I mean my own peculiar Peggotty—made such impressive motions to me not to ask any more questions, that I could only sit and look at all the silent company, until it was time to go to bed. Then, in the privacy of my own little cabin, she informed me that Ham and Em’ly were an orphan nephew and niece, whom my host had at different times adopted in their childhood, when they were left destitute: and that Mrs. Gummidge was the widow of his partner in a boat, who had died very poor. He was but a poor man himself, said Peggotty, but as good as gold and as true as steel—those were her similes. The only subject, she informed me, on which he ever showed a violent temper or swore an oath, was this generosity of his; and if it were ever referred to, by any one of them, he struck the table a heavy blow with his right hand (had split it on one such occasion), and swore a dreadful oath that he would be ‘Gormed’ if he didn’t cut and run for good, if it was ever mentioned again. It appeared, in answer to my inquiries, that nobody had the least idea of the etymology of this terrible verb passive to be gormed; but that they all regarded it as constituting a most solemn imprecation.", "sha256": "ba11b7d243c022a8a6917f4e2519aa30e212791925eb86dcebed5d315fcce059", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[47]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0047", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I was very sensible of my entertainer’s goodness, and listened to the women’s going to bed in another little crib like mine at the opposite end of the boat, and to him and Ham hanging up two hammocks for themselves on the hooks I had noticed in the roof, in a very luxurious state of mind, enhanced by my being sleepy. As slumber gradually stole upon me, I heard the wind howling out at sea and coming on across the flat so fiercely, that I had a lazy apprehension of the great deep rising in the night. But I bethought myself that I was in a boat, after all; and that a man like Mr. Peggotty was not a bad person to have on board if anything did happen.", "sha256": "8c2aab518c9dd7dce6f1138bd38be50dde48ebd6656df21d7130bcb45ce767ad", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[48]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0048", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Nothing happened, however, worse than morning. Almost as soon as it shone upon the oyster-shell frame of my mirror I was out of bed, and out with little Em’ly, picking up stones upon the beach.", "sha256": "0e05e3712ac1e4281e8bcc781fb02674318faedf53622528f81e987875a72ffe", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[49]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0049", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘You’re quite a sailor, I suppose?’ I said to Em’ly. I don’t know that I supposed anything of the kind, but I felt it an act of gallantry to say something; and a shining sail close to us made such a pretty little image of itself, at the moment, in her bright eye, that it came into my head to say this.", "sha256": "a528ffad575456299ffbceffec63c96498067a313ba0f5db17de33071ec47f1c", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[50]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0050", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘No,’ replied Em’ly, shaking her head, ‘I’m afraid of the sea.’", "sha256": "a8d98d1d59cda65e918b9feb3d62e5b4633da7eb8980241692bbba20dc88e1be", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[51]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0051", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Afraid!’ I said, with a becoming air of boldness, and looking very big at the mighty ocean. ‘I an’t!’", "sha256": "c538dca93552d51eaa597431f96cc50afbfc2217bfb153708f8abbe7b08fa0fd", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[52]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0052", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Ah! but it’s cruel,’ said Em’ly. ‘I have seen it very cruel to some of our men. I have seen it tear a boat as big as our house, all to pieces.’", "sha256": "b87a208907b9c8b4e8ff9f877e78be56ee2d07a5a8fe5dd916df870fb735f733", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[53]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0053", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘I hope it wasn’t the boat that—’", "sha256": "30a8398207954a35bb63de1358e64667c0a117b0b02e7239d13e78b0503dcbf7", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[54]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0054", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘That father was drownded in?’ said Em’ly. ‘No. Not that one, I never see that boat.’", "sha256": "6459249885668069ff912cfef5e20a1084a5da6ca0c25d68972fa652a80bbbda", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[55]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0055", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Nor him?’ I asked her.", "sha256": "97ce70db9513809425a7272f15dcd94f5019d131b3ccfb1e3543e702767a605b", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[56]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0056", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Little Em’ly shook her head. ‘Not to remember!’", "sha256": "5e1e140239e70d6603693459f9e7082fda3844a57c906351f1118613a4a40339", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[57]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0057", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "Here was a coincidence! I immediately went into an explanation how I had never seen my own father; and how my mother and I had always lived by ourselves in the happiest state imaginable, and lived so then, and always meant to live so; and how my father’s grave was in the churchyard near our house, and shaded by a tree, beneath the boughs of which I had walked and heard the birds sing many a pleasant morning. But there were some differences between Em’ly’s orphanhood and mine, it appeared. She had lost her mother before her father; and where her father’s grave was no one knew, except that it was somewhere in the depths of the sea.", "sha256": "5ff119a6eb5ef0ce8f3f64658de569f4d3783f5e5e3369307ade6755ca877a86", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[58]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0058", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Besides,’ said Em’ly, as she looked about for shells and pebbles, ‘your father was a gentleman and your mother is a lady; and my father was a fisherman and my mother was a fisherman’s daughter, and my uncle Dan is a fisherman.’", "sha256": "e5d82611c689f59dbf7291d9c6659aa6a922735260058c0add03ab4e7ecaf3d1", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[59]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0059", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Dan is Mr. Peggotty, is he?’ said I.", "sha256": "72d470cd6340d18079b3e39e06fdbce424b1a39b4f0092e858318358adb3eece", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[60]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0060", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Uncle Dan—yonder,’ answered Em’ly, nodding at the boat-house.", "sha256": "d001a387bc51f656639d61086bf5d5a33c4fc021ed0be2eda591471dfb57f9c6", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[61]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0061", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Yes. I mean him. He must be very good, I should think?’", "sha256": "bedc77a746fc219b699e09f2239efdfd3de7023b9a52f241e9fefebbf4803641", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[62]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0062", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "‘Good?’ said Em’ly. ‘If I was ever to be a lady, I’d give him a sky-blue coat with diamond buttons, nankeen trousers, a red velvet waistcoat, a cocked hat, a large gold watch, a silver pipe, and a box of money.’", "sha256": "b9bc476c3debeacc42089dbcfcba8f00b79f12b16425e412c0370b382f58e653", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[63]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}, {"id": "en85-u005-b0063", "tag": "p", "role": "paragraph", "text": "I said I had no doubt that Mr. Peggotty well deserved these treasures. I must acknowledge that I felt it difficult to picture him quite at his ease in the raiment proposed for him by his grateful little niece, and that I was particularly doubtful of the policy of the cocked hat; but I kept these sentiments to myself.", "sha256": "fd7a1f5e4bd7f7c4bb6539c86376ab930176d37ac0ae8e28d2f746eeda9a528f", "source_xpath": "/html/body/div[10]/p[64]", "emphasis_spans": 0, "bold_spans": 0, "smallcaps_spans": 0, "note_markers": [], "source_class": ""}]}
